title: Aera
intro_text: A renovated three-story villa in the leafy alleys of Da'an District. Six young professionals from Taipei, Tokyo, and Seoul have moved in together, agreeing to let their lives and ambitions be observed. Two doors down the lane in the production control room, the monitors are glowing and your crew is waiting for your first call. You are the showrunner. The story begins where you choose to look.
help_text:
Frequently used commands:
{available_commands}
- Tab switches focus between command and transcript
- Up/Down recalls command history when command is focused
- Up/Down scrolls the transcript when transcript is focused
- PageUp/PageDown/Home/End scroll the transcript faster
- ? opens the menu

subtext_notes: This is an unscripted reality television simulation set in Da'an, Taipei.
The player is the Showrunner / Lead Producer stationed in the Video Village control room.
Six housemates live in the villa; three production crew members assist the player.
